    14	16.1 Overview
    15	The Lilypad Diaspora wishes to establish enclaves as

    21	discard pile for frog cards called the pond. However, 
    22	their Peaceful enclaves cannot protect them. To gain 
    23	warriors, they need enclaves on their militant side. 
    24	But these enclaves cover their clearing’s suit as the Di­
    25	aspora expels threats real or imagined, making them 
    26	lose essential Woodland support. They also prompt the 
    27	Diaspora to retaliate, making them battle at them ev­
    28	ery turn. To prevent this, they can reconcile to flip 
    29	Militant enclaves to Peaceful, and their enemies can do 
    30	the same through negotiations. However, their ene­
    31	mies may battle the Diaspora to flip Peaceful enclaves 
    32	to Militant, as their people’s fears come to pass.
    33	16.2 Faction Rules and Abilities
    34	16.2.1     Enclaves. The Diaspora has 12 enclave tokens, 
    35	which are double-sided: one side is Peaceful and 
    36	the other side is Militant. Each clearing can hold 
    37	only one enclave.
    38	I     Clearing Suit. While Peaceful, an enclave 
    39	adds the frog suit to its clearing, making it du­
    40	al-suited. While Militant, an enclave replaces 
    41	its clearing suit with the frog suit. (A crafting 
    42	piece at a Peaceful enclave can be used for a frog 
    43	icon or the printed clearing icon. A crafting piece at 
    44	a Militant enclave can be used only for a frog icon. 
    45	The frog icon can be used as a wild icon.)
    46	II     Matching. Various effects target a clearing 
    47	matching the suit of something else, such as a 
    48	card. A clearing with a Militant enclave can be 
    49	matched with the frog suit. A clearing with a 
    50	Peaceful enclave can be matched with either the 
    51	frog suit or the printed clearing suit. (For exam­
    52	ple, the Lizard Cult could Build with a frog card to 
    53	place a fox garden in a fox clearing with a Peaceful 
    54	enclave, since it also has the frog suit. The Woodland 
    55	Alliance could spend a fox and a frog card to revolt 
    56	in a fox clearing with a Peaceful enclave.)
